assigned_motion: The integration of generative AI tools in the professional development of graduate students not only hinders their critical thinking skills but also their need to be epistemically responsible.
motion_provenance: Exact text supplied by the user from a Moodle manual item; not independently authenticated.
scope: Targeted motion-specific research; not an exhaustive systematic review.

sources.title: Topic of Social Responsibility Debate
sources.author: Moodle manual item, supplied by the user
sources.summary_zh: 本题原文逐字保存；“need” 的歧义必须公开处理。
sources.summary_en: The exact supplied motion is preserved; address the ambiguity of “need” explicitly.
sources.limit_zh: 用户提供的条目是本版命题依据；未独立登录 Moodle 核验分组或更新。
sources.limit_en: The user-supplied item is the basis; allocation and subsequent Moodle changes were not independently checked.

sources.title: The Impact of Generative AI on Critical Thinking: Self-Reported Reductions in Cognitive Effort and Confidence Effects From a Survey of Knowledge Workers
sources.author: Lee, H.-P., Sarkar, A., Tankelevitch, L., Drosos, I., Rintel, S., Banks, R., & Wilson, N.
sources.summary_zh: 较高 AI 信心与较少自报思考相关。
sources.summary_en: Greater AI confidence was associated with less reported thinking.
sources.limit_zh: 自报关联；不是研究生长期技能测验。
sources.limit_en: Self-report association, not a longitudinal graduate skill test.

sources.title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning: Evidence from high school mathematics
sources.author: Bastani, H., Bastani, O., Sungu, A., Ge, H., Kabakcı, Ö., & Mariman, R.
sources.locator: Author manuscript pp. 1–2, 6–7, 11; unassisted exam results
sources.summary_zh: 无护栏组撤除 AI 后相对低约 17%；护栏组与对照无显著差异。
sources.summary_en: After removal, the unguarded group scored about 17% lower relative to control; the guarded group was not significantly different.
sources.limit_zh: 高中数学；17% 不是 17 个百分点；无显著差异不等于完全相同。
sources.limit_en: School mathematics; 17%, not 17 percentage points. Non-significance is not equivalence.

sources.title: AI tutoring outperforms in-class active learning: an RCT introducing a novel research-based design in an authentic educational setting
sources.author: Kestin, G., Miller, K., Klales, A., Milbourne, T., & Ponti, G.
sources.locator: PDF pp. 2–3 Results; p. 6 Context/limitations; p. 7 Methods
sources.summary_zh: 定制 tutor 的即时测验结果较好。
sources.summary_en: A custom tutor produced better immediate quiz results.
sources.limit_zh: 教学组合，不是普通聊天；未测长期高阶判断。
sources.limit_en: A teaching package, not ordinary chat; no durable higher-order judgment measure.

sources.title: ChatGPT and its impact on research supervision: Insights from Australian postgraduate research students
sources.author: Dai, Y., Lai, S., Lim, C. P., & Liu, A.
sources.summary_zh: 访谈报告自主性、研究与思考上的帮助。
sources.summary_en: Interviews reported help with autonomy, research and thinking.
sources.limit_zh: 人群贴题；经验报告不等于因果提升。仅核读摘要。
sources.limit_en: Relevant population; accounts are not causal gains. Abstract checked only.

sources.title: Cognitive offloading and metacognitive calibration in generative AI-mediated doctoral learning: a grounded theory study of accountable reconstruction
sources.author: Gao, L., & Zhang, F.
sources.summary_zh: 区分直接替代理解与核验后自己重建。
sources.summary_en: Distinguishes substituted understanding from checked, reconstructed understanding.
sources.limit_zh: 适合解释过程，不估计普遍比例。
sources.limit_en: Useful for processes, not prevalence estimates.

sources.title: Fabrication and errors in the bibliographic citations generated by ChatGPT
sources.author: Walters, W. H., & Wilder, E. I.
sources.locator: Abstract; Methods: Paper topics and prompts; Results
sources.summary_zh: 2023 年特定输出中，GPT-3.5 / GPT-4 的伪造比例为 55% / 18%。
sources.summary_en: In specified 2023 outputs, fabricated-reference rates were 55% / 18% for GPT-3.5 / GPT-4.
sources.limit_zh: 旧模型输出审计；没测学生是否相信，更不是当前错误率。
sources.limit_en: An older output audit; not student credulity or current error rates.

sources.title: Critical Thinking in the Age of Generative AI: Effects of a Short-Term Experiential Learning Intervention on EFL Learners
sources.author: Cong-Lem, N., Nguyen, T. T., & Nguyen, K. N. H.
sources.date: International Journal of TESOL Studies, online 28 May 2025
sources.locator: §3.1–3.3, pp. 6–9; limitations p. 15; Appendix A pp. 16–17
sources.summary_zh: 90 分钟工作坊后，自报思维量表提高。
sources.summary_en: Reported thinking scores rose after a 90-minute workshop.
sources.limit_zh: 非随机分组、自报、即时测量。

sources.title: Should We Discourage AI Extension? Epistemic Responsibility and AI
sources.author: Naeem, H., & Hauser, J.
sources.locator: §§4–5: Epistemic Integration; Defeaters, Design, and Policy
sources.summary_zh: 作者论证：依靠 AI 并不必然不负责任；关键是使用者能对形成信念的过程之可靠性保持敏感。
sources.summary_en: The authors argue that reliance on AI need not be irresponsible if users remain sensitive to the reliability of their belief-forming process.
sources.limit_zh: 哲学论证说明可能性和条件，不证明普通学生已经具备这些能力；覆盖范围也不限于生成式 AI。
sources.limit_en: A philosophical account of possibility and conditions, not evidence that typical students meet them; its scope is broader than generative AI.

sources.title: Australian Code for the Responsible Conduct of Research 2018
sources.author: NHMRC, Australian Research Council & Universities Australia
sources.locator: Principles P1–P3, P7; researcher responsibilities R22, R23, R27
sources.summary_zh: 规范强调诚实、严谨、透明、问责，并要求准确记录、负责传播、及时纠错与准确引用。
sources.summary_en: The code emphasizes honesty, rigour, transparency and accountability, including accurate records, responsible dissemination, correction and citation.
sources.limit_zh: 规范证明应承担什么责任，不证明 AI 实际改变了责任履行；并非专门针对本次课程作业的 AI 使用许可。
sources.limit_en: Establishes responsibilities, not the empirical effect of AI on compliance; it is not permission to use AI in this specific assignment.

sources.title: Guidance for generative AI in education and research
sources.author: Miao, F., & Holmes, W. / UNESCO
sources.locator: Human-centred approach; pedagogical design and validation
sources.summary_zh: 以人为中心的教育与研究使用指导，强调教学设计、伦理验证和人的能动性。
sources.summary_en: Human-centred guidance for educational and research use, emphasizing pedagogical design, ethical validation and human agency.
sources.limit_zh: 指导文件不是干预效果研究；推荐的防护措施是否有效仍需测量。
sources.limit_en: Guidance is not an intervention evaluation; safeguard effectiveness still needs measurement.

sources.title: AI Policies and Guidelines
sources.author: Monash University
sources.locator: Links to academic research guidance and shared responsibility model
sources.summary_zh: 公开目录列出研究 GenAI 指导和共享责任模型，详细材料需学生 / 教职员权限。
sources.summary_en: The public directory points to academic-research guidance and a shared-responsibility model; detailed materials require student/staff access.
sources.limit_zh: 未读取受限正文，不据此编造 Monash 或本作业的 AI 使用规则。
sources.limit_en: Restricted documents were not read; no specific Monash or assignment permission is inferred.

sources.title: FIT5122 — Assignment 2: Social Responsibility Debate
sources.author: Monash University / FIT5122
sources.date: 文件未注明发布日 / undated
sources.summary_zh: 四页作业原件：双方准备、六段赛程、人人发言、提交要求与评分表。
sources.summary_en: Four-page assignment: both sides, six timed segments, participation, submission and rubric.
sources.limit_zh: PDF 没有列出具体命题；本版命题来自用户提供的 Moodle 条目。日期、分组、道具仍应核对。
sources.limit_en: The PDF omits the motion; this pack uses the Moodle wording supplied by the user. Confirm calendar date, allocation and props.

sources.title: Debating Rules
sources.author: Microsoft MakeCode AP CSP
sources.locator: Team Line; Speakers; Importance of Rebuttal; Manner; Judging
sources.summary_zh: 作业指定规则；要点见规则章。
sources.summary_en: Assigned rules; see the rules section.
sources.limit_zh: 传统三辩格式；本作业的明确赛程和 rubric 另列。
sources.limit_en: Traditional format; the assignment specifies its schedule and rubric separately.

sources.title: ACS Code of Professional Conduct, v2.1
sources.author: Australian Computer Society
sources.summary_zh: 课程提供版本的六项价值：公众利益、生活质量、诚实、能力、专业发展、专业精神；冲突时公众利益优先。
sources.summary_en: Course version: public interest, quality of life, honesty, competence, professional development and professionalism; public interest takes precedence in conflicts.
sources.limit_zh: 这是专业规范，不能单独证明某政策有效；不要称作 2023 职业伦理准则。
sources.limit_en: A professional standard does not establish policy effectiveness; distinguish it from the 2023 ethics code.

sources.title: A Framework for Ethical Decision Making
sources.author: Markkula Center for Applied Ethics, Santa Clara University
sources.locator: Six Ethical Lenses; A Framework for Ethical Decision Making
sources.summary_zh: 在线框架含权利、公正、效用、共同善、美德和关怀六种视角。课程两页节选为 2009 修订版，列出五种方法。
sources.summary_en: The online framework has six lenses: rights, justice, utility, common good, virtue and care. The two-page course extract is the 2009 revision with five approaches.
sources.limit_zh: 框架组织判断，不能自动消除价值冲突或替代实证研究。
sources.limit_en: The framework structures judgment; it does not resolve every value conflict or replace evidence.

sources.title: Toulmin Method for Argument Development & Revision
sources.author: Claremont Graduate University, Center for Writing & Rhetoric
sources.summary_zh: 把主张、根据、推理桥梁、桥梁支撑、限定条件和例外拆开检查。
sources.summary_en: Separate claim, grounds, warrant, backing, qualifier and rebuttal conditions.
sources.limit_zh: 这是可被反驳的论证结构，不等于形式逻辑中的必然演绎。
sources.limit_en: This structures defeasible arguments, not logically necessary deduction.

sources.title: Introduction to Ethics for Information Technology Professionals
sources.author: FIT5122 course material; adapted from Alexandra; acknowledges Kirsten Ellis & Ann Nicholson
sources.summary_zh: 课程入门阅读区分规则导向与后果导向，并强调利益相关者的不同影响。
sources.summary_en: Course introduction contrasts rule-oriented and consequence-oriented approaches and differing stakeholder impacts.
sources.limit_zh: 入门简化，不应推成所有义务论都没有例外，或后果论完全不需要规则。
sources.limit_en: An introductory simplification, not proof that all deontology has no exceptions or consequentialism has no use for rules.

course_originals: Course-only originals remain in the local preparation pack and are not published.
